Extraordinarily high quality and stunningly beautiful. The gameplay is satisfying, sure, and there is a moderate degree of variety between escape attempts, but the game shines the most in its vibrant worlds, stunning artwork, fantastic voice acting and audio design, and even pleasant cinematography on occasion.
